summary: Iter 14 — Professional Mode E2E backend + frontend smoke. 21 pytest cases (20 PASS, 1 SKIPPED due to real bug — see below). All three-account flows work end-to-end: Priya CRUD + pause/reactivate/delete lifecycle; Sana verified-pro category-scoped /professional/requests + offer via POST /api/connect/request (help_request_id) is IDEMPOTENT + Priya accept → match created → private_details unlocks in GET /help-requests/{id}; Jade unverified profile correctly masks qualifications="Under review"/memberships="" while viewer is another user, Jade CAN still submit /verification, admin (kauri, is_demo) can approve/reject/more_info via /admin/verifications/{sub_id}/decision; approval flips verified_by_intro=true. Professionals listing sorts verified first, verified_only + category filters work. GPS never leaks in professional/requests responses. Block flow (Priya blocks Sana → Sana no longer sees Priya's request). Decline flow correctly keeps private_details locked. People-mode regression (login kauri, register+delete fresh account, demo delete 403, /api/nearby with lat+lng) all pass. FRONTEND SMOKE (Priya token, mobile viewport 390x844): Professional Home renders correctly with 'I Need Help' + 'I Can Help' cards after mode switch; AppModeSwitch shows People/Professional segments; /professional/need-help edit form renders categories/summary/private/payment/expiry/save (existing TEST_iter14 block test request pre-filled); /professional/verification renders full 3-step submission form; /admin-verifications renders Verification Queue with 4 status tabs. No red screens, no JS errors. Two known cosmetic RN warnings persist (shadow* deprecation + PingModal pointerEvents) — carry-over from iter 12/13. BUGS FOUND: (1) [MED] public_user() at server.py:184-225 does NOT include app_mode or professional_role → after mode switch persisted via PUT /users/me/mode, /auth/me does not surface app_mode, so cross-device / cold-load sync of the persisted mode is broken (local AsyncStorage masks this). (2) [LOW] POST /api/blocks has no unblock / delete endpoint (server.py:1331 is upsert-only). Frontend cannot un-block a user through the API; only a fresh test can reset via DB. (3) [MED-TEST] Missing testIDs on /professional/need-help form fields (hr-summary, hr-save, hr-pause, hr-delete, hr-category-*, hr-payment-*) — makes automation brittle; had to fall back to visible-text selectors. (4) [DOC] `GET /api/vibes` still returns opportunity with hidden:True. Frontend VibePicker filters `!hidden` so users never see it — behaves correctly, but review requested opportunity be 'GONE'; consider removing entry entirely.

rca_of_issue: public_user gap: PUT /api/users/me/mode $sets app_mode+professional_role directly on the user doc but public_user() (server.py:184-225) hand-lists returned fields and omits both. Effect: after a page refresh the frontend AppContext restores appMode ONLY from AsyncStorage (AppContext.tsx:136-138) — on a fresh device / new browser the persisted server value is invisible. Fix is a 2-line addition to public_user. Blocks endpoint: POST /api/blocks (server.py:1331) upserts and never deletes; the only clearing path today is DELETE /api/users/me which is unrelated. Report + hide side effects (server.py:1387-1389) mean a Sana→Priya /reports call auto-hides Priya from Sana; three medium-risk 'Scam' reports also flip Priya.admin_status='hidden_pending_review' making her invisible to all pros — this was the root cause of the initial 'This user is not available' 403 in the offer test between runs, and is documented (not a bug per se, but review of report-thresholding may be warranted since 'Scam' is a legitimate reason).
